cues.en: Kamen Riders... as loathsome a lot as ever.

Kamen Riders... as loathsome a lot as ever.
But today, that history comes to an end.

So, two of you remain...
Then you two shall be the sacrifice that completes my revenge.
The flame of hope will die, and arrogant humanity will remember...

The flame of hope will die, and arrogant humanity will remember...
...that they were always meant to be ruled.
